title: Projection dependency registry
root_cause: Skill-derived semantic, cognitive, graph, registry, and package projections have no single revision-bound dependency inventory.
source_requirement: Declare projection inputs, owners, costs, invalidation rules, and rebuild gates.
implementation_steps: Register current skill projections and builders.
Classify cheap synchronous versus expensive fail-closed rebuilds.
Bind every projection to source revisions.
affected_tests: Generated artifact, semantic index, cognitive index, and graph tests.
evidence_required: Registry validation and deterministic invalidation/rebuild plan vectors.
rollback: Disable registry consumers and retain current projection files without claiming freshness.
acceptance_criteria: Every registered projection has dependencies, builder, invalidation, and rebuild gate.
